info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Picklists API
Salesforce Get Picklist Values for a Record Type

params.name: objectApiName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact, MyObject__c)

params.name: recordTypeId
params.description: The record type ID or the string '012000000000000AAA' for the master record type

items.docs: Returns picklist values for all picklist fields on an object for a given record type. Values include labels, valid values, and dependencies between picklist fields.
